# Price Lists

Part of the **Products** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List price lists

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/products/price-lists`

Retrieve a paginated list of price lists with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: currency, company, creator, items | `currency,items` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by price list name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[currency_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of currency IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[is_active]` | boolean | No | Filter by active state |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `sort` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/price-lists?include=currency%2Citems&sort=sort&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

## Create price list

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/products/price-lists`

Create a new price list together with its pricing rules

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Price list name (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `currency_id` | integer | Yes | Currency the price list is expressed in. Orders using this list adopt its currency. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Leave empty to share the price list across companies. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `sort` | integer | No |  |
| `is_active` | boolean | No | Whether the price list can be applied to new orders. |
| `items` | object[] | No | Price rules. The most specific rule that matches a product decides its price. |
| `items[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `items[].display_apply_to` | string | No | Whether the rule targets a product or a category. Defaults to product. |
| `items[].type` | string | Yes | How the price is computed: fixed, percentage or formula. |
| `items[].base` | string | No | Price the rule starts from: list_price, standard_price or price_rules. |
| `items[].product_id` | integer | No | Product the rule applies to. Leave empty to cover all products. Pass a variant to scope the rule to that variant alone. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `items[].category_id` | integer | No | Category the rule applies to. Leave empty to cover all categories. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `items[].base_price_list_id` | integer | No | This field is required when items.*.base is price_rules. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `items[].min_quantity` | number | No | Quantity, in the product unit of measure, from which the rule applies. Must be at least 0. |
| `items[].fixed_price` | number | No | Unit price used when the rule type is fixed. |
| `items[].percent_price` | number | No | Discount percentage used when the rule type is percentage. Negative applies a mark-up. |
| `items[].price_discount` | number | No |  |
| `items[].price_markup` | number | No |  |
| `items[].price_round` | number | No | Must be at least 0. |
| `items[].price_surcharge` | number | No |  |
| `items[].price_min_margin` | number | No |  |
| `items[].price_max_margin` | number | No |  |
| `items[].starts_at` | string | No | Must be a valid date. |
| `items[].ends_at` | string | No | Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to items.*.starts_at. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/price-lists" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Wholesale",
  "currency_id": 1,
  "company_id": 1,
  "sort": 16,
  "is_active": true,
  "items": [
    {
      "id": 16,
      "display_apply_to": "product",
      "type": "fixed",
      "base": "list_price",
      "product_id": 1,
      "category_id": 1,
      "base_price_list_id": 16,
      "min_quantity": 10,
      "fixed_price": 42.5,
      "percent_price": 25,
      "price_discount": 4326.41688,

      "starts_at": "2026-10-12T10:50:03",

    }
  ]
}'
```

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The price list ID |




::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X DELETE "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/price-lists/{id}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('DELETE', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/price-lists/{id}', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',

    ],
]);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/products/price-lists/{id}"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.delete(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```
